title: Pay regime
description: One pay regime as data. Romanian statutes, the Danish state/region/municipal agreements and hypothetical proposals are all instances of this one document type. Nothing in here is jurisdiction-specific.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 plus optional tier, e.g. RO, DK-stat, DK-kommune

minorUnits.description: Decimal places in the currency's minor unit. All engine arithmetic is in integer minor units.

reference.description: The single multiplier both systems share. base = positionValue x amount x factor, rounded. RO: amount = valoarea de referinta (4100 RON), factor = 1, unit = coefficient. DK: amount = 1, factor = reguleringsprocent, unit = absolute, and positionValue is the frozen basisbeloeb at baseDate.

baseDate.description: Date the position values are expressed in. RO: date the coefficients were set. DK stat: 2012-03-31, region: 2018-03-31, kommune: 2000-03-31.

unit.description: Presentation hint only. The arithmetic is identical.

period.description: The period a position value resolves to. Romanian coefficients yield a monthly salariu de baza; the Danish basic amounts are annual. Without this the engine would happily add a Danish year to a Romanian month, so payslip() refuses to emit a figure whose period it cannot name.

rounding.description: Default rounding for anything derived from this reference. Individual ladders, positions and supplements may override it - the Danish state tables round the basic salary scale to whole kroner but leave supplements at two decimals.

growthCapId.description: id of a cap of kind 'growth' that constrains how amount may rise year on year

grades.description: System-wide bands of position value. RO: the 12 grade salariale of Art. 9(2). DK: empty - Danish bands are per position, expressed as variant.range.

ladders.description: Seniority progressions, keyed by id. A regime may have several; a position names the one it uses, or none.

caps.description: Plural and typed. RO has at least three structurally different caps; DK has none.

levies.description: Ordered deductions and contributions. Includes occupational pension, which in DK is the dominant one and is split employee/employer.

limitations.description: What this regime document deliberately cannot compute, in the author's own words. The UI must render these where the affected number is shown - not in a footnote.

provenance.description: Required on every number that could be argued with.

locator.description: Article/annex/sheet+cell, e.g. 'Art. 13 alin. (3) lit. b)' or "sheet 'IX A'!G10"

confidence.description: verbatim: copied from the source. derived: computed from it, formula recorded in note. assumed: not in any source document yet - must be resolved before publication.

valueSeries.description: A number, or a dated step function. Annex IX phases dignitary coefficients 2026->2031; the Danish reguleringsprocent is redated twice a year; the RO reference value is set annually by HG. One primitive covers all three.

step.description: In minor units. 100 = round to a whole leu / whole krone.

kind.description: compoundingUplift: each step multiplies the previous salary (RO gradatii). absoluteSteps: each step names its own position value (DK scale grades).

bakedInto.description: Position kinds for which the top step is already inside the published value and must not be applied again. RO Art. 10(6): functii de conducere carry the maximum gradatie inside the coefficient.

fromYears.description: Lower bound of the seniority band this step corresponds to.

value.description: absoluteSteps only. A position value in the same unit as positions[].variants[].value.

positionKind.description: Drives whether a ladder applies at all, not pay level.

code.description: The source's own code where one exists (RO: the 81.10101002.02.2 form in the coefficient workbook). Importer-assigned codes must say so in provenance.note.

name.description: Canonical display title. When the source merges several former titles into one row, this is the first of them and the rest live in titles[].

titles.description: Every job title the source places on this one position. A draft-law row such as 'Director; sef compartiment; inspector sef; comisar sef divizie; ...' is nine formerly distinct titles now sharing one code, one coefficient and one grade. The merge is a fact of the source cell, so it belongs to the regime rather than to a crosswalk. Cross-REGIME mappings (153/2017 -> draft 2026) live in data/crosswalks instead.

qualifier.description: Trailing qualifier that applies to every title in the row, e.g. 'studii superioare lunga durata grad didactic I'. Held separately so it is not mistaken for a title.

assimilation.description: How titles[] was obtained. The split is contested - the workbook uses ';' both between titles and inside them - so the original string is kept verbatim and every parse records how much to trust it.

rawTitleCell.description: The source cell exactly as written, punctuation and double spaces included. Never regenerated from titles[].

parse.description: single: one title, no merge. semicolon/comma/slash: split cleanly on that separator. mixed: separators nest, e.g. titles by ';' with a shared qualifier after a ','. needsReview: at least one fragment does not look like a job title and a human must rule. All three separators are ambiguous somewhere in the workbook - ';' also appears inside single titles, ',' also introduces qualifiers, '/' also appears inside one title as in 'secretar institutie/unitate de invatamant' - so the parse is a claim, not a fact.

fanIn.description: Number of former titles collapsed here. 1 means no merge.

family.description: Occupational family. RO: one of the 7 familii ocupationale / annex number. DK: bargaining area.

studyLevel.description: As written in the source: S, SSD, M, PL, G, M/G, MSc, BSc.

ordonator.description: Ordonator principal de credite this position sits under, when the source pins it. Needed for cap scoping.

dims.description: Names of the axes that split this position into variants: gradProfesional, gradManagerial, treapta, institutionLevel, vechimeBand. Empty when the position has a single value.

ladder.description: id of a ladder in ladders, or null when seniority does not move this position.

ladderPath.description: Ordered step ids this position actually walks, repeats allowed. DK bachelors walk grades 1,2,4,4,5. Omit to walk the ladder's own step order.

range.description: Where the source gives an interval rather than a point: DK specialist/senior consultants, RO functii de conducere grad managerial I-II set by the head of institution.

gradeId.description: id in grades[] this variant is placed in by the source. The engine checks it against min/max rather than trusting it.

modifier.description: Annex II Art. 10: the same coefficient is applied +/-15% by unit category. A modifier on the value, not a supplement - it moves the base and therefore the cap denominator.

institutionFactor.description: Where pay varies by the kind of institution rather than by the job, the variation belongs here as an explicit multiplier on one position — not as several positions sharing a title. The draft does the opposite: 95 of its positions carry variants that differ only by institutional tier, one of them by a factor of 1,5 under a single name.

mode.description: fixed: the law states the rate (Art. 14, 10%). upTo: the law states a ceiling and someone downstream picks (Art. 15, up to 40%). This distinction is the whole point of Art. 21 and must not be flattened.

rate.description: Proportion of base, e.g. 0.40. Use with base = baseSalary | referenceValue | hourlyRate.

amount.description: Absolute value in position-value units, multiplied by reference like any position value. DK supplements are all of this form.

base.description: What the rate is applied to. Art. 19 (handicap, 15%) is on the reference value, not on the base salary - a different number for everyone.

countsToCap.description: Whether this supplement enters the numerator of the cap named in capId. 'partial' is required by Art. 15(18)-(19): the externally-funded share is exempt, the co-financed share counts.

capId.description: Which cap this is measured against. Defaults to the first cap of kind shareOfBase.

countsWhen.description: Machine-readable condition naming the person/scenario field that decides the split, e.g. 'cofinancingShare'.

ladder.description: id of a ladder this supplement escalates along, when it has its own seniority scale independent of the base salary. DK raadighedstillaeg.

levyOverrides.description: Per-component levy rates. The Danish availability supplement carries 12,50% pension where the basic salary carries 18,07%.

excludes.description: Supplement ids that cannot be drawn at the same time. Annex II Art. 1: the 15% three-shift supplement replaces the 25% night supplement.

maxStaffShare.description: Ceiling on the share of an institution's staff who may draw it. Annex II Art. 7(5): 10% for level I dangerous conditions, 20% for the rest. Ignored by payslip(), binding in aggregate().

condition.description: Prose condition the engine cannot evaluate, e.g. Art. 23's local tax-revenue ratio test. Surfaces as a diagnostic.

kind.description: shareOfBase: Art. 21(2), 20% of the base wage bill; Art. 22(6), 4% for performance premia. shareOfHeadcount: Art. 22(7), at most 30% of posts. growth: Art. 9(4), the reference value may not rise faster than nominal GDP. shareOfGdp: Art. 36(3), the whole wage bill must fall by at least 1.5 points of GDP between 2024 and 2031 - a target on an external statistic rather than on anything the payroll controls.

scope.description: Art. 21(2) is per ordonator principal, per funding source. It is NOT a per-person cap; a payslip can only ever show a notional utilisation.

boundTo.description: The external series this cap is measured against. Required for kind 'growth' and 'shareOfGdp'. A dangling reference is a validation error: a rule the statute states but the model cannot evaluate must say so through a limitation, not through a string nobody resolves.

dataset.description: id of a document in data/fiscal/

baselinePeriod.description: shareOfGdp: the period the target is measured from. Art. 36(3) names 2024.

targetPeriod.description: shareOfGdp: the period the target must be met by. Art. 36(3) names 2031.

deltaPp.description: shareOfGdp: required change in percentage points. Negative for a reduction. Art. 36(3): at least -1.5.

penalty.description: What the source attaches to breach. Art. 35(2): 30 000-50 000 lei plus recovery.

split.description: Required when payer = split. DK occupational pension: 1/3 employee, 2/3 employer. This is what feeds payslip.pensionSplit.

bands.description: Progressive schedules. Unused by RO (flat) but required for any honest DK income tax, which is why net is currently null for DK.

deducts.description: Levy ids subtracted before applying this one. RO impozit deducts cas and cass.

inGross.description: true when the levy is added into gross rather than taken out of it. DK pension is quoted on top of the netted basic salary.
